Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ShieldAgent: Shielding Agents via Verifiable Safety Policy Reasoning (2503.22738v1) · paper method: The decision thresholds the probability difference between invoking an action and taking no action,with an adjustable safety threshold.

cohort7.claim.shieldagent.threshold

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Equation5 holds other predicate values fixed; higher epsilon represents stricter configured requirements. This condition is internal to the learned policy model,not a guarantee of external-world safety.
